releaseTitle: AdSkip Pro v1.0.40 - Fixed Screen Lock & User-First Listening Protection
releaseNotes:
* Fixed Screen Lock & AMOLED ECO Mode: Resolved UI thread crash and added FLAG_KEEP_SCREEN_ON to prevent device display timeout; double-tap unlock is now instantaneous anywhere on the screen with haptic feedback
* Seamless Automation Passthrough: Added withAutomationBypass so that accessibility frame capture and ad dismissal taps execute cleanly without being intercepted or blocked by the black screen overlay
* User-First Listening Protection: Completely eliminated unsolicited auto-starting when opening Pocket FM to listen to episodes; engine stays peaceful and IDLE during normal browsing and playback
* Full Background Battery Optimization: Black Screen ECO mode turns off OLED pixels while ads play, saving maximum battery while keeping continuous episode unlocking active in pockets or bags
